title: (Im)balance in the Representation of News? An Extensive Study on a Decade Long Dataset from India
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any benchmarks related to faith or religion. Its focus is on quantifying political imbalance in Indian news media concerning political parties and geographical coverage.
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion. It mentions 'communal disharmony' as a motivating problem and plans to study 'religious and community-wise polarization' as future work, but the current study focuses exclusively on political imbalance.
